'''Cloudy''' {{Lang|zh=白咩}} is a quest-exclusive [[NPC]] and, by extention of [[Encore]], a member of the [[Black Shores]]. [[Cosmos]] and Cloudy, once ordinary dolls gifted to Encore by her [[Encore's Mother|mother]], are sentient as manifestations of Encore's imagination and are believed to represent her forte abilities. The two always stay by her side and also assist her in [[Encore/Combat|combat]].
